name: Ink & Ivory
description: Bracket pale discs and turn a small board in your favor.
mechanic: Disc-flipping territory against a three-ply positional opponent.
rules: You play ink first. Place on a dotted square so a straight line of pale discs ends at another ink disc. All bracketed discs turn ink.
The house follows the same rules. A player without a legal move passes automatically. The game ends when neither can move.
Most discs wins. Corners cannot be flipped; the house values stable corners and edges.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Four Together
description: Drop, threaten, block. Make an unbroken line of four.
mechanic: Gravity alignment against a depth-four tactical opponent.
rules: Choose a numbered column to drop an ink disc into its lowest empty space. The house then drops a pale disc.
Connect four horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to win. A full column cannot accept another disc.
A full board without a winning line is a draw. The house looks ahead for wins and threats.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Seed & Store
description: Sow a handful. Capture a bowl. Bring the harvest home.
mechanic: Six-bowl Kalah seed sowing with captures and extra turns.
rules: Choose one of your six lower bowls. Sow its seeds one at a time to the right, into your store, across the upper row to the left, then back around. Skip the house store.
Last seed in your store earns another turn. Last seed in your empty lower bowl captures that seed and any seeds in the opposite bowl, if it is occupied.
When either row empties, remaining seeds go to their owner’s store. Most stored seeds wins.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Matchstick Market
description: One row at a time. Leave the house without the last word.
mechanic: Normal-play three-heap Nim against an exact mathematical opponent.
rules: Remove any positive number of matches from one row on each turn. Buttons show row and amount.
The house removes matches by the same rule. Whoever takes the final match wins.
There is no luck. The house plays optimal Nim; the opening is winnable with careful play.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Fence & Field
description: A line becomes a square. A square becomes yours.
mechanic: Dots-and-boxes area capture with chained extra moves.
rules: Tap an empty edge between dots. Complete the fourth edge of a square to claim it.
Claiming a square earns another edge. The house captures available squares and avoids giving away easy ones.
When all nine squares are claimed, the larger collection wins.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Last Pebble
description: Jump a quiet garden down to one solitary stone.
mechanic: Seven-peg orthogonal jump solitaire on a diamond garden.
rules: Select a pebble, then a highlighted empty hole two spaces away. The pebble between them is removed.
Jumps are horizontal or vertical, never diagonal. Select another pebble to change your mind.
Leave exactly one pebble. This handcrafted arrangement has a six-jump solution; a board with no legal jumps ends the round.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Royal Crossing
description: Protect a path and send one pawn to the far bank.
mechanic: Breakthrough pawn racing with diagonal captures against lookahead AI.
rules: Select an ink pawn, then a highlighted destination. Ink moves upward one row; the house moves downward.
Move straight into an empty square, or diagonally into an empty square or an enemy pawn. Captured pawns leave the board.
Reach the opposite edge first, capture all enemy pawns, or leave the opponent with no move to win.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Hidden Fleet
description: Sound a little bay and account for every vessel.
mechanic: Battleship-style spatial search with known fleet constraints.
rules: Tap a square to sound it. A diamond marks a vessel; a cross marks open water.
The fleet contains three straight vessels of lengths 3, 2, and 2. Vessels never touch, including diagonally.
Find all seven occupied squares in as few soundings as possible. The handcrafted chart stays the same on replay.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Border Guild
description: Claim valuable districts. Make their shared edges count.
mechanic: Alternating territory drafting with adjacency and denial scoring.
rules: You and the house alternate claiming one district. Each printed number is its base influence.
Every shared horizontal or vertical edge between your districts adds 2 influence. Each edge scores once.
After all sixteen districts are claimed, most influence wins. The house weighs value, connections, and blocking your growth.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Orchard Keeper
description: Plan a twelve-day harvest with a small supply of rain.
mechanic: Deterministic resource-and-time management on nine planting plots.
rules: Plant an empty plot for 2 water. Every action advances one day and ripens planted trees by one step.
A tree is ripe after three actions, including its planting day. Tap a ripe tree to harvest 4 fruit and clear its plot. Collect rain spends a day to gain 3 water.

Gather 20 fruit in twelve days. Five plantings need more than your starting 8 water: make time to collect rain, ripen trees, and harvest. Unharvested trees do not score. Nothing advances while you are away.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Narrow Bridge
description: A step forward, or a fence that makes the other route longer.
mechanic: Pawn racing with limited route-preserving edge barriers.
rules: Your ink courier starts below; the house starts above. Reach the opposite row first. Walk one adjacent square. When facing the other courier, jump straight over it; if a wall or edge blocks that jump, step sideways around it instead.
Or choose Place a fence, then two neighboring squares. A fence blocks only their shared edge. Each side has three fences.
Fences may never remove every route to either goal. The house walks a shortest route or builds a useful detour. Sixty turns without a winner is a draw.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Sixfold
description: Weave a continuous thread across six-sided neighborhoods.
mechanic: Hex connection on a four-by-four rhombus against distance-aware AI.
rules: You place ink stones and connect top to bottom. The house places pale stones and connects left to right.
Each hex touches up to six neighbors: left, right, above, below, upper-right, and lower-left. Stones never move after placement.
The first connected chain across its two banks wins. The house takes immediate wins, blocks immediate threats, and shortens its route.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Watchtower
description: Three towers. Twenty-five corners to keep in sight.
mechanic: Queen-ray coverage optimization with a three-piece placement budget.
rules: Place three towers on the board. Each watches its complete row, column, and both diagonals. Towers do not block one another.
Dotted squares are watched. Tap a placed tower to lift it and try another square.
Cover all twenty-five squares, then Seal the plan. Partial coverage earns a score, and a complete arrangement exists.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Quiet Siege
description: Move your queen, close a square, and keep a corridor open.
mechanic: Compact Amazons territory trapping against mobility-aware AI.
rules: Your ink queen moves any distance along a clear row, column, or diagonal. Choose a highlighted destination.
Then close one empty square visible along a clear line from your new position. Closed squares stay blocked for the round.
The house does the same. Trap its queen so it has no legal move, while keeping room for your own.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.

name: Trading Day
description: Eight public prices. One considered trade each day.
mechanic: Finite-horizon inventory trading with public price calendar.
rules: Start with 12 coins and room for three crates. Each day choose to buy one crate, sell one crate, or wait.
The entire eight-day price calendar is visible. You can only buy what you can afford and sell what you hold.
After day eight, remaining crates sell automatically at the final price. Finish with at least 24 coins.
controls: Tap or click the board and action buttons. Tab to a control; Enter or Space selects. Arrow keys move focus between board squares.
